Locksmith Services Near Huntington, NY

Huntington is a North Shore town with a walkable village of shops and restaurants, historic homes near the harbor, and newer neighborhoods toward Huntington Station and Melville. Older houses often have original hardware that deserves careful work, while village businesses need reliable locks and exit devices. Haven Locksmith serves Huntington and nearby Huntington Station, Melville, Cold Spring Harbor, and Northport.
